section_summary.extract_value: This section describes the participants for a single study (Study X) comprising 3621 undergraduate females from a large publicly-funded institution in the Southeastern United States. The sample had a mean age of 19.4 years, was predominantly White/European American (62%) and Black/African American (21%), with a mean BMI of 23.5 kg/m2. The majority were freshman and sophomore students (76.5%), and 86.5% were non-psychology majors.
